newsitem.title: UK: Dlr/yen soft in morning Europe, all eyes on G7.
newsitem.headline: Dlr/yen soft in morning Europe, all eyes on G7.

text.p: The dollar slipped slightly from overnight highs above 126 yen in morning Europe, weighed down by a slide in Japanese government bonds overnight amid fresh concern about the health of the financial system in Japan, traders said.
The shutdown of a big Japanese insurer, Nissan Mutual Life Insurance Company, triggered concern that Nissan's foreign bonds would be liquidated, thus causing a large repatriation of funds.
But the dollar's movements were not dramatic and expected to remain limited ahead of weekend's Group of Seven (G7) meeting of finance ministers and central bankers in Washington.
